data.name: Black Sun
data.detailed_description:
General information:

Black Sun is a survival horror role playing game about a world that has fallen into disrepair as a result of alien occupation. There are no more authorities, law enforcement agencies, or infrastructure. People are looking for any opportunity to live one day longer, joining gangs and committing outrages, while the aliens pursue their mysterious, unknown goals.

You will have to survive in an environment filled with despair, injustice and fear, fighting for your right to exist against various opponents. Desperate laborers, homeless people and drug addicts, tech hunters, armed gangs and creepy alien creatures will not stop at the opportunity to kill, rob or scrap you.

Main character:

You play as C-310, a product of the secret Zarya robotics laboratory located near the Krasnov-12 city-forming enterprise. Your past is vague, and your future is unknown. You will have to find your own way in the world of Black Sun, fighting your way through enemies, helping others and solving difficult situations.

The player has a variety of tools in his arsenal to solve various tasks, ranging from standard weapons such as pistols and shotguns, to abilities that are unlocked only when using advanced augmentations, cybernetic modules, or unique high-tech weapons.

The Center of Russian Robotics:

Krasnov-12 is city-forming industry in central Russia specializing in industrial and military robotics.

The streets of the city and its surroundings are filled with the atmosphere of modern Russia, tinged with cyberpunk, post-Soviet paraphernalia and suffering from the effects of an alien invasion and general madness.

You will explore the surroundings of the city, its central and suburban parts, high-rise buildings, factories, entertainment centers or their ruins.

  • The atmosphere and visual style of the game world constantly keep you in suspense and have a depressing effect on the player.

  • Realistic and natural characters. They get angry, dumb, swear, have speech defects, and are indistinct in expressing their thoughts and emotions. But some of the characters can be cold-blooded, pragmatic, infallible, and ruthless.

  • A character modification system that allows the player to select modifications and weapons for certain situations and for certain opponents.

  • The locations of the game are crafted with great attention to detail - the player will be able to interact with most doors and explore every corner.

  • Non-linear quests and storylines. Each quest has several development options, as a result of which not only the reward for the player is decided, but also the fate of characters or even entire communities.

  • The system of changing the time of day opens up new opportunities for the player, or takes away old ones.

  • There are many solutions that improve the player's quality of life (QoL), saving the player from unnecessary running, wasting nerves and possible unpleasant experiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel / AMD processor, 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
